formCss:
<style>
/* Maibo Blue Edition identity sign-in, using the official Casdoor formCss hook. */
body:has(.login-content) {
  background: #fafafa;
  color: #0d0d0d;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
}
.login-content .login-panel,
.login-content .login-panel-dark {
  border: 1px solid #e0e6ed;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 38px rgba(30, 70, 107, 0.06);
}
.login-content .login-form {
  color: #0d0d0d;
}
.login-content .login-logo-box {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.login-content .ant-input,
.login-content .ant-input-affix-wrapper,
.login-content .ant-select-selector {
  border-color: #e0e6ed;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.login-content .ant-btn-primary {
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #1e466b;
  border-color: #1e466b;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-content .ant-btn-primary:not(:disabled):hover {
  background: #153a5b;
  border-color: #153a5b;
}
body:has(.login-panel-dark) {
  background: #0d1722;
  color: #f2f6fa;
}
.login-content .login-panel-dark {
  background: #142536;
  border-color: #30475c;
}
.login-panel-dark .login-form {
  color: #f2f6fa;
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .login-content {
    padding-inline: 16px;
  }
  .login-content .login-panel,
  .login-content .login-panel-dark {
    max-width: 100%;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
}

.login-content .ant-input:focus,
.login-content .ant-input-affix-wrapper-focused {
  border-color: #1e466b;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(103, 186, 244, 0.22);
}
.login-content .ant-checkbox-checked .ant-checkbox-inner {
  background-color: #1e466b;
  border-color: #1e466b;
}
.login-panel-dark .ant-btn-primary {
  background: #67baf4;
  border-color: #67baf4;
  color: #0d1722;
}
.login-panel-dark .ant-btn-primary:not(:disabled):hover {
  background: #8acbfa;
  border-color: #8acbfa;
  color: #0d1722;
}
</style>
